visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit exhibition hall designed as a futuristic cafe. A robotic arm with white casing and green leaf graphics is centrally positioned, rotating as it prepares a drink. In the background, liquid dispensers with orange and red contents are visible next to a silver 'NEO MIX STAND' machine. Yellow and black text overlays are prominent. (2) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the robotic arm as it precisely grips a clear plastic cup filled with yellow fruit chunks. It moves with a slow, deliberate motion towards a dispensing nozzle. Behind the equipment, a staff member in a green uniform and apron is partially visible, attending to the back-end preparations. (3) The scene shifts to show the cup being filled with a reddish-pink liquid from an automated dispenser. Another robotic arm operates in the background. The environment is clean and tech-heavy, with various mechanical components and small digital interfaces surrounding the workspace. (4) The setting transitions to an outdoor courtyard under bright daylight. A male main character with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a white smartwatch, holds the completed drink which has a yellow lid and colorful character sticker. He shakes the cup vigorously using both hands while looking towards the camera. (5) The character takes a sip of the drink, showing an appreciative facial expression. He then speaks directly to the camera, holding the cup in the foreground to showcase it. The video concludes with a grayscale freeze-frame of him smiling warmly while gesturing with the cup towards the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic electronic dance track featuring a prominent synthesizer melody and a steady, upbeat rhythm. A male voice introduces the experience with a high-pitched, friendly tone and fast articulation. The acoustic background contains a faint industrial hum from an indoor exhibition hall. (2) A subtle mechanical whirring sound is heard as the robotic arms move. The speaker comments on the robot's appearance, his voice exhibiting high arousal and positive valence. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A distinct mechanical 'clack' SFX marks the interaction between the robotic arm and the beverage cup. The speaker's pitch variability increases as he expresses surprise at the slow pace of the robot. (4) The background noise floor shifts to include a low-frequency wind texture and distant outdoor chatter. The BGM continues as the primary speaker begins his review. SFX of liquid being poured is audible. (5) A light percussive 'tap' sound occurs as the speaker handles the cup. He sips the drink, followed by an expressive vocalization 'Oh!' with a clear rising intonation. The track concludes with a conversational banter where the speaker's tone becomes comedically exaggerated.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and review a novel robotic beverage preparation experience at the Osaka Expo 2025, emphasizing its cute design despite its slow operational speed, and providing a subjective taste test.
